title: Oil Spills Wreak Havoc on the Bottom of the Ocean, Even a Decade Later
summary: Across hundreds of miles of the northern Gulf of Mexico, a deepwater ecosystem collapsed after the massive 2011 Deepwater Horizon oil and gas spill, and recovery is uncertain, new research concludes.
